text: Attrition [Lat. attritus , from atterere , to rub]: Ger. Attrition ; Fr. attrition ; Ital. attrizione . These are degrees of sorrow for sin -- conviction of guilt, implying contrition, being the highest. Attrition is the name given to sorrow proceeding from some lower motive, e.g. fear of future consequences. ( R.M.W .)
